name: National Scholarship Portal - Pre-Matric Scholarship (SC/ST/OBC)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / Ministry of Tribal Affairs
description: A central scholarship scheme supporting SC, ST, and OBC students studying in Class 1 to 10, reducing dropout rates by covering basic education-related expenses, applied for through the single-window National Scholarship Portal.
benefits: Monthly scholarship typically ranging from Rs. 150 to Rs. 550 depending on whether the student is a day scholar or hosteller, plus an annual ad-hoc grant and book allowance, paid directly to the student's (or parent's) Aadhaar-linked bank account.
eligibility: Student must belong to SC, ST, or OBC category
Enrolled in Class 1 to Class 10 in a recognised school
Family income must be within the scheme's prescribed ceiling
Aadhaar and Aadhaar-linked mobile number required for One Time Registration (OTR) on NSP
how_to_apply: Complete One Time Registration (OTR) on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) using Aadhaar and mobile number, then apply under the relevant Pre-Matric scheme. Application must be verified by the school/institution before final approval.
